filters.label: Filters
filters.priceNote: Price filters use the cheapest approved study package and leave out courses without one. Videos are free either way; currencies are not converted.

home.emptyAll: Published courses will appear here as soon as they go live.

best.label: Bestseller
best.ruleTitle: How the bestseller label is decided
best.ruleSubtitle: The label follows a published rule based on real, non-refunded purchases.
best.ruleNote: The rule is evaluated by a daily job on the server. Nothing is estimated or padded; courses that do not meet the rule are simply not labelled.

categories.title: Categories
categories.subtitle: Browse every topic and academy on Mastemy.

academy.meta: {name}: career paths, featured collections and the newest live courses.
academy.subtitle: {n} live courses in this academy
academy.empty: No live courses in this academy yet.

cert.title: Certification preparation
cert.subtitle: External certifications and qualifications, with the Mastemy courses that help you prepare.
cert.meta: Prepare for {title} ({issuer}): exam facts checked against the official source, blueprint and preparation courses.
cert.noPartnership: Mastemy is not the exam provider. Listing a certification does not mean Mastemy is affiliated with, endorsed by or a partner of its issuer, and passing a Mastemy assessment does not grant it.
cert.noPartnershipNamed: Mastemy is not affiliated with, endorsed by or a partner of {issuer}. This page summarises public information for preparation only; passing a Mastemy assessment does not grant this certification.
cert.search: Search by title or exam code
cert.emptyBody: Entries appear only after a reviewer has checked them against the official source within the last 180 days.
cert.officialWins: Always confirm details on the official source. If anything here differs from it, the official source is correct.
cert.nonMcqTitle: This exam includes tasks that are not multiple-choice
cert.noBlueprint: No objectives have been published for this entry.
cert.weightPartial: The listed objectives cover {n}% of the exam weight.
cert.prepNote: Lesson videos in these courses are free. Mastemy practice is multiple-choice and does not replicate the official exam.

pathways.title: Career paths
pathways.subtitle: Ordered sequences of live courses that build toward a goal.
pathways.enrolled: Enrolled in {n} new courses ({m} already enrolled).
pathways.loginToEnroll: Log in to enroll in this path
pathways.freeNote: Enrolling is free and all lesson videos are free. Optional study packages are bought per course.

collection.title: Collection
collection.meta: {title}: a curated collection of live Mastemy courses.

instructors.title: Instructors
instructors.subtitle: People teaching live courses on Mastemy.

packages.title: Learning packages
packages.subtitle: What paid study packages include, and the free-video boundary they never cross.

what.title: What a package contains
what.body: A package is an optional study service for one course, such as premium notes, larger MCQ banks, mock exams or downloadable resources. Each package lists its included services, price and access period on the course page.

never.title: What a package never includes
never.body: Video access. Every lesson video stays free to watch on YouTube with or without a package, and paying never unlocks or removes a video.

review.title: Reviewed before sale
review.body: Instructors propose packages; Mastemy staff review the actual contents before a package can be bought.

compare.title: Decide after watching
compare.body: Watch the free lessons first. If the extra study services help you, choose a package on the course page.

packages.none: No courses offer a study package yet.

practice.title: Practice MCQs
practice.subtitle: How multiple-choice practice works on Mastemy.

where.title: Where to find practice
where.body: Practice questions live inside each course: lesson practice sits next to the lesson video, and modules and courses can add tests and exams.

how.title: How it works
how.body: Sign in, open a lesson and start practice. Questions are single-answer or clearly labelled multiple-answer, and grading happens on the server.

explain.title: Explanations for every option
explain.body: After you answer, each option shows why it is right or wrong, so you learn from mistakes and lucky guesses alike.

limits.title: What practice is not
limits.body: Practice results help you see what you know; they are not a prediction of an external exam score.

notes.title: Notes library
notes.subtitle: Study notes written for each lesson, next to the free video.

free.title: Free study notes
free.body: Instructors can publish free notes for each lesson. They appear on the lesson page beside the video.

premium.title: Premium notes
premium.body: Some courses add premium notes as part of a study package. The video and free notes stay available without it.

private.title: Your own notes
private.body: Signed-in learners can keep private, timestamped notes on any lesson and find them again on their notes page.

notes.liveNote: Open a course's lessons to read the notes its instructor has published. Not every lesson has notes.

business.title: Business training
business.subtitle: Organization workspaces for training teams with Mastemy courses.

workspace.title: Organization workspaces
workspace.body: An organization gets a workspace with admins and managers, a seat limit and member invitations by email, individually or in bulk.

assign.title: Course assignments
assign.body: Assign live courses to the whole organization, a department or one member, with an optional due date. An assignment can include the course's study package for covered members.

progress.title: Progress reporting
progress.body: Managers see member progress on assigned courses and can download it as CSV.

free.title: Videos stay free
free.body: Lesson videos are free for everyone, so teams only need an organization for assignments, reporting and study packages.

articles.title: Articles
articles.subtitle: Plain explanations of how Mastemy works.
articles.englishOnly: This article is currently available in English only.

coverage.summary: {covered}% of the exam weight covered; {gaps} of {n} objectives have gaps.

studio.skillsNote: Choose up to {n} skills from the catalogue. Changes reach the public course page at the next publish.
studio.noSkills: The skills catalogue is empty. Staff can add skills in the admin area.
studio.skillsSaved: Skills saved. They appear publicly after the next publish.
studio.certNote: Map lessons and questions to a certification's objectives and check coverage. Staff must link the course to the certification first.
studio.replaceLessons: Saving replaces this course's lessons mapped to the objective (currently {n}). Select every lesson that should stay mapped.
studio.replaceQuestions: Saving replaces this course's questions mapped to the objective (currently {n} active). Select every question that should stay mapped.
studio.noLessons: This course has no lessons yet.
studio.noQuestions: This course has no questions yet.
studio.activeOnly: Only Active questions count toward coverage.

admin.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens; used in the public URL.
admin.pickerHint: Type at least 2 characters. Only live courses can be added.
admin.userSearchUnavailable: User search needs the Support or Admin role.

skills.title: Skills catalogue
skills.subtitle: Skills that courses, pathways and questions can reference.
skills.codeRule: 1 to 64 characters: letters, digits, dot, underscore or hyphen, starting with a letter or digit.
skills.name: Name
skills.unknownTitle: Question skill codes not in the catalogue
skills.unknownBody: A soft check: questions can use any code, but codes outside the catalogue cannot be used for filtering.
skills.unknownNone: Every question skill code is in the catalogue.

certs.title: Certification directory
certs.subtitle: Issuers, certifications, objectives and verification. Every change is audited.
certs.noIssuers: No issuers yet. Add one before creating certifications.
certs.slugHint: Leave empty to derive it from the title.
certs.lastCheckedHint: Date you last checked the official source. Must be within {n} days to verify; cannot be in the future.
certs.nonMcqHint: Shown publicly. Required before verification when the box above is checked.
certs.editClears: Saving changes clears the current verification. A reviewer other than you must verify the entry again before it is public.
certs.staleQueueHint: Verified-state entries that are stale or lost verification through an edit.

rule.https: An https official source URL is set.
rule.reviewer: You are not the last editor (a second person verifies).
rule.nonMcq: A non-MCQ disclosure is written (required when the exam has non-MCQ tasks).
rule.objectives: At least one objective (Preparation in production / Preparation available).
rule.liveCourse: At least one linked live course (Preparation available; checked by the server).
rule.edit: Any edit to fields or objectives clears the verification until someone else verifies again.
rule.retired: Retired entries can only be reopened as research candidates.

certs.weightHint: 0 to 100; all objectives together cannot exceed 100.
certs.deleteObjective: The objective and its lesson and question mappings are removed. This clears the verification.
certs.linksNote: Link or unlink a course. The admin API does not list current links; the coverage below counts every linked course, and the public page lists linked live courses once the entry is visible.

pathways.title: Career paths
pathways.subtitle: Ordered course sequences shown on /pathways. Only live courses are shown publicly.
pathways.publishedHint: Published paths with at least one live course appear publicly.
pathways.deleteBody: The career path is removed. Courses and enrollments are not affected.

collections.title: Collections
collections.subtitle: Editorial and topic collections. Active editorial collections without a category are featured on the home page; collections with a category are featured on that academy.
collections.categoryHint: Optional. Shown on that academy page instead of the home page.
collections.deleteBody: The collection is removed. Courses are not affected.

best.title: Bestsellers
best.subtitle: Results of the last bestseller computation.
best.runSummary: {considered} courses considered, {eligible} eligible. Window from {from}, computed {at}.
best.rule: By default a course is a bestseller only with at least 10 distinct qualifying buyers in the last 30 days (paid, not refunded or in refund, not an author or staff account). The server configuration decides.
best.empty: No results yet. Recompute to fill the table.
best.revenueNote: Net revenue is summed as recorded; currencies are not converted.

ideas.title: Course ideas
ideas.subtitle: Production backlog. Ideas are never shown publicly.
ideas.private: Ideas are internal and never shown publicly. Approved needs an owner and an update owner; In production needs a linked course; Published needs that course to be live.
ideas.linkedHint: Paste a course ID or find a live course below.
ideas.deleteBody: The idea is deleted. Ideas in production or published cannot be deleted.
ideas.importBody: Parses the “| # | Candidate | Group | Brief |” table into ideas. Existing titles are skipped, so running it again is safe. Leave the box empty to use the roadmap file configured on the server.
ideas.markdownHint: Paste the roadmap table, or leave empty.
ideas.importSummary: Last import: {parsed} rows parsed, {created} created, {skipped} skipped.
